frontmatter.name: scroll-scrubbed-visual-sequence
frontmatter.description: Build reversible scroll-controlled visual transformations with a pinned or sticky stage, normalized progress, and video, image-sequence, canvas, SVG, or DOM renderers. Use for hero transformations, product assembly, interface state walkthroughs, object rotation, diagrams, or photo sequences that must move forward and backward with native scrolling.

frontmatter.name: scroll-scrubbed-word-reveal
frontmatter.description: Reveal marked-up text word by word as scroll progress advances, while preserving semantic inline links, emphasis, responsive line wrapping, and reduced-motion readability. Use for headlines, quotes, manifestos, product statements, onboarding messages, or editorial passages where scrolling should pace comprehension rather than simulate typing.

frontmatter.name: masked-reveal
frontmatter.description: Create masked staggered word reveals on scroll with GSAP ScrollTrigger. Use when headings, hero copy, section titles, or editorial text should reveal word-by-word through an overflow mask as they enter the viewport.
